For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] The late-night study shown in <Picture 1> is preserved: a roughly ten-square-metre, nearly square room with dark blue-grey walls and pale wood flooring; the front wall is a large rain-night window covered in condensation, with orange-red neon blooming in the night beyond the glass and a dark curtain hanging on the left side of the window; in front of the window stands a dark wooden desk holding a silver laptop with its cold white screen lit, a warm desk lamp, a pen cup, a small stack of books and an open draft notebook, with a black swivel chair in front of the desk; along the left wall hang a chalkboard print, a coat rack carrying a coat and a tall fiddle-leaf fig; along the right wall runs a row of wooden sideboards, their top carrying two black speakers side by side, a small potted plant and a black-and-white decorative print; a few more potted plants are scattered along the walls and in the corners, and a light-coloured rug covers the floor.
This set of objects makes up the entire contents of the room and stays the same set throughout the whole video, with appearance, number and position fixed the whole way through: the number of sideboard drawers does not change, the two black speakers always sit side by side at the same spot on the sideboard top, the potted plants are always the same few, the laptop, the desk lamp, the pen cup and the open draft notebook always remain at their original positions on the desk top, and the coat on the rack is always the same coat.
The camera is fixed at the very centre of the room at a height of about one and a half metres and stays in place the entire time, the lens holds an eye-level view, the height stays one and a half metres from start to finish, the horizon stays level, the vertical lines of the walls and the sideboards stay vertical, the floor runs along the bottom edge of the frame and the ceiling along the top edge.
From the opening frame onward the camera rotates clockwise in place at a constant angular rate, turning about 36 degrees every second, and that angular rate stays unchanged from start to finish; a quarter turn takes exactly a quarter of the time, and the full circle is completed in one continuous rotation within 10 seconds; throughout the rotation every object in the room stays in its original place, each one enters and leaves the view only by way of the left or right edge of the frame, and the rest of the frame remains a continuous travel of that same set of objects.
From 0.00 s to 2.50 s the camera turns from the front to the right face: the window, the desk and the objects on the desk top travel out of the frame as a group toward the left edge, while the row of wooden sideboards that sat on the right side of the frame in the first frame, together with the two black speakers side by side on their top, that small potted plant and that black-and-white decorative print, enter from the right edge of the frame and gradually move to the centre; the black swivel chair is still in front of the desk and travels to the left edge of the frame together with the desk, and the light-coloured rug and the pale wood floor remain one continuous plane.
From 2.50 s to 5.00 s the camera turns from the right face to the back: the whole row of sideboards keeps travelling out toward the left edge of the frame with only its far end coming to rest at the left edge, the back wall enters from the right edge of the frame and gradually moves to the centre, it is the same dark blue-grey wall as the other three faces and is carried on from the same pale wood floor and the same light-coloured rug, slightly left of the centre of this wall is a dark wooden door, and this door is the only one on the wall.
From 5.00 s to 7.50 s the camera turns from the back to the left face: the dark wooden door travels out toward the left edge of the frame, the wall that sat on the left side of the frame in the first frame enters from the right edge of the frame and gradually moves to the centre, the chalkboard print, the coat rack carrying the coat and the tall fiddle-leaf fig move into the centre of the frame one after another, the coat is still the same coat and the fiddle-leaf fig is still the same plant.
From 7.50 s to 10.00 s the camera turns from the left face back to the front: the chalkboard print, the coat rack and the fiddle-leaf fig keep travelling out toward the left edge of the frame, the large condensation-covered rain-night window, the dark curtain on the left side of the window, the dark wooden desk in front of the window and the silver laptop on its top re-enter from the right edge of the frame and return to their opening positions, the black swivel chair returns to its original place in front of the desk, and the frame at 10 seconds matches the first frame at 0.00 seconds exactly.
The whole thing is captured in a single shot, and the frame is one and the same continuous space from start to finish.

overall_soundscape: Rain keeps tapping against the window glass, the laptop fan hums low, there is a faint electrical hiss near the desk lamp, the wooden floor gives small creaks as the camera turns, and a car occasionally rolls over the wet road in the distance; the whole is a quiet late-night interior atmosphere.

non_diegetic_music: Low piano notes unfold slowly with sustained strings underneath, the volume stays pressed very low throughout, and it progresses slowly as the camera completes one even rotation, resolving back to the opening pitch as it closes.

## 3010-首帧场景 (I2VA 8秒/24fps, 4步/20步 可切)

- 模型: minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_bf16.safetensors
- 切换: FallingTSSwitch — True=4步 (turbo LoRA + euler + shift 6/3)
                          False=20步 (无 LoRA + res_multistep + simple + shift 12/3 内置默认)
- 缓存: EasyCache (0.2/0.15/0.7) 仅挂 20步分支; 4步分支只用 LoRA, 不经过缓存
- 帧数 = 秒数x24 对齐 17k+5 网格
- 输出: 24fps

- 缓存: EasyCache (0.2/0.15/0.7) 仅挂 20步分支; 4步分支只用 LoRA, 不经过缓存
- 帧数 = 秒数x24 对齐 17k+5 网格
- 输出: 24fps
